question: In which of the following States was the 37th National Junior Athletics Championship held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **37th National Junior Athletics Championships 2022** were held in **Guwahati, Assam**.
 
• The event took place at the **SAI Athletics Stadium** in Guwahati, bringing together junior athletes from across the country to compete in various track and field events.
 
• The event was organized under the aegis of the **Athletics Federation of India (AFI)** in collaboration with the local athletics association in Assam.
 
• **Tajinder Singh** (Punjab)
 
 
• He clocked a time of **10.60 seconds** to win the event, setting a new **National Junior Record**
 
 
 
• **Bharti Sharma** (Haryana)
 
 
• She finished first with a time of **11.65 seconds**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Junior Athletics Championships **is an annual event held by the Athletics Federation of India (AFI).**
 
• The 39th National Junior Athletics Championships took place from October 25–29, 2024 at the Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. 
 
• The **AFI also hosts other junior athletics championships, including: **
 
 
• **North Zone Junior Athletics Championships: **Held in 2024 at JLN Stadium in New Delhi from October 10–12
 
• **South Zone Junior Athletics Championships**: Held in 2024 at Acharya Nagarjuna University in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh from October 17–19
 
• **East Zone Junior Athletics Championships: **Held in 2024 at Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar, Odisha from October 7–9
 
• **West Zone Junior Athletics Championships: **Held in 2024 at RSTM Nagpur University Ground in Nagpur from October 4–6
 
 
 
• The AFI's registered office is located in Delhi.
